stages.name: External grant authority closeout
stages.summary: Verify the completed Stage 2D canonical external grant table and runtime provider boundary before later stages are installed.

stages.name: Appwrite storage and evidence authority
stages.summary: Install Appwrite Storage and TablesDB evidence authority while retaining an explicit Firebase fallback for rollback and emulator compatibility.

stages.name: Transaction and recovery safety
stages.summary: Retain and verify the existing Appwrite transaction commit/rollback capability and Development rollback workflow.

stages.name: Runtime parity and worker authority
stages.summary: Install a distinct canonical client approvals model and remove independent tenant grant creation authority from notification workers.

stages.name: Development personas and representative fixtures
stages.summary: Retain and verify the seven required portal identities, entitlements and representative Development fixtures.

stages.name: Structured UAT readiness
stages.summary: Require local seven-portal acceptance and the consolidated readiness gate without depending on GitHub Actions.

stages.name: Offline inspector field operations
stages.summary: Install canonical idempotent offline sync receipts and retain queue persistence, replay, conflict and recovery semantics.

stages.name: Migration dry-run and reconciliation
stages.summary: Verify the existing dry-run, checksum, reconciliation, rerun and recovery framework before representative migration testing.

stages.name: Shopify Development integration
stages.summary: Verify Shopify integration contracts and require the exact Development store target before integrated UAT.

stages.name: Google worker Development integration
stages.summary: Verify canonical worker/outbox contracts and require an explicitly declared non-Production Google Cloud project before integrated UAT.

stages.name: Environment bootstrap
stages.summary: Pin and verify Node, npm, Appwrite CLI, clean Git state and safe Development environment variables before remote mutation.

stages.name: Security and recovery hardening
stages.summary: Run secret scanning, dependency policy, tenant isolation, grant misuse, recovery and failure-safe gates before Development mutation.

stages.name: Testing performance polish
stages.summary: Enforce the front-end performance budget as part of local testing readiness.
